import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test.json')
assert not path.exists()
plan_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test_plan.json')
plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
selection = json.loads(Path(plan['selection_file']).read_text())
assert file_sha256(plan['selection_file']) == plan['selection_sha256']
assert selection['status'] == 'frozen' and selection['eval_batch_size'] == 4
assert file_sha256(selection['adapter_file']) == selection['adapter_sha256']
folder = Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_selected_test')
meta = json.loads((folder / 'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert meta == plan['metadata'] and meta['is_private']
assert meta['enable_gpu'] and meta['enable_internet']
assert file_sha256(folder / meta['code_file']) == plan['source_sha256']
env = {**os.environ, 'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR': str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY', 'KAGGLE_API_TOKEN', 'KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):
    env.pop(name, None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python', 'scripts/kaggle_quota.py'], env=env, check=True)
snapshot = json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
quota = snapshot['quota']
available = quota['gpu_seconds_total'] - quota['gpu_seconds_used'] - quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
other = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_grpo_validation.json').read_text())
remaining = max(0, other['session_timeout_seconds'] - (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - datetime.fromisoformat(other['submitted_at'])).total_seconds()) if other['status'] == 'submitted' else 0
cap = plan['session_timeout_seconds']
assert 15900 <= cap <= 43200 and available >= remaining + cap
command = ['kaggle', 'kernels', 'push', '-p', str(folder), '--accelerator', 'NvidiaTeslaT4', '--timeout', str(cap)]
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'acquire one immutable validation-selected newest-family test policy'}, selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'plan_sha256': file_sha256(plan_path),
          'selection_sha256': plan['selection_sha256'], 'metadata': meta, 'source_sha256': plan['source_sha256'],
          'quota_snapshot': snapshot, 'available_seconds': available, 'remaining_native_grpo_cap_seconds': remaining,
          'session_timeout_seconds': cap, 'status': 'submitting',
          'submitted_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'polls': []}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
record['push'] = {'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'output': result.stdout, 'error': result.stderr}
version = re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)', result.stdout)
actual = re.search(r'https://www.kaggle.com/code/([^/\s]+/[^/\s]+)', result.stdout)
if actual:
    record['requested_kernel'] = meta['id']
    meta['id'] = actual[1]
record.update(status='submitted' if result.returncode == 0 and version else 'push_requires_inspection', version=int(version[1]) if version else None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert record['status'] == 'submitted', 'Inspect ambiguous submission before any retry'
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel': meta['id'], 'version': record['version'], 'accelerator': 'T4 x2 requested',
    'start': None, 'end': None, 'hours': None, 'submitted_at': record['submitted_at'], 'private': True,
    'status': 'submitted', 'source_commit': record['provenance']['git_commit'], 'receipt': str(path),
    'session_timeout_seconds': cap, 'purpose': 'Only frozen primary Qwen3.8-27B policy; sealed test 200/game.',
    'hours_basis': 'Pending downloaded runtime; cap is not measured usage.'})
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Submitted selected test', meta['id'], record['version'], flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python', '-u', 'scripts/watch_kaggle.py', '--receipt', str(path),
                '--out', f"results/kaggle/qwen38-selected-test-v{record['version']}"], check=True)
